business.description: Vallabh Steels Limited is engaged in the iron and steel industry. The company recorded revenue from operations of Rs. 0.03 lakh in FY 2025-26, same as previous year, primarily due to shortage of working capital.

plants.location: G.T. Road, Village Pawa, Sahnewal, Ludhiana-141120, Punjab
plants.capacity: Tube Mill, Cold Rolled Mill (no production activity during the year)

outlook.statement: Steel demand in India is expected to grow in 2025-26 based on expected growth in different sectors.

The outlook for the industry looks promising. Indian Steel demand did very well show an upward trend, setting a road ahead for the growth of the domestic steel industry in the years to come. However, on account of shortage of working capital the company's performance began to nose dive.
It is expected that the company will be able to tide over working capital constraints and better trends will emerge and may improve also in the times ahead.

risks: Shortage of working capital facilities adversely affecting bank borrowings and performance
